title: Français 3758 — Châtillon, 3 August 1635
contents: Châtillon criticizes the army’s condition and discusses withdrawal across the Rhine for greater safety.
fields: 78 signs: 56 letter signs, 20 in nomenclature, 2 repeat controls.

excerpt: **Cette consideration les pourra empescher de s’engager si avant,** mais Je Vous respon que **nous ne jouons point de ruse cete fois, mais nous passons le Rhin pour nostre plus grande seurete afin d’avoir se grand fleuve entre les ennemis et nous.**
translation: This consideration may prevent them from advancing so far; but I assure you that we are playing no trick this time. We cross the Rhine for our greater safety, in order to have this great river between the enemy and ourselves.
